title: DayCountActualActual is inside the CONTRACT domain and outside the GRADED domain, so an implementation must refuse it with ErrNoDiscriminatingVector rather than return a number. The arm is both re-derived (T30) and captured (58 captures in .softhouse/capture/actualactual/), but nothing has been PROMOTED, and T48's finding N4 is why promotion is not a formality: where both calendar years have the same length the per-year fractions sum to the plain fraction EXACTLY, so a cross-year shape inside a run of non-leap years grades a port identically whether it implements the arm or not.

provenance.note: Derived from the ratified contract's own normative text, which IS the specification. No oracle output is compared, so this vector carries no monetary value at all and is tallied separately from parity.
provenance.citation: nexus/internal/apps/loanschedule/contract/contract.go:406-412 (DayCountActualActual: 'Outside the graded domain — refuse with ErrNoDiscriminatingVector'), with the graded-domain list at :1128 (DayCount == DayCountFixed30Over360)
